findings.detail: Tool "omnigate_runtime_execute" appears informational but accepts parameters (script) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: script, capsule_id, budget_usdc, input, mode, payment_header, credit_token, arc_auth_id

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?registry=scriptmasterlabs" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: spend_gate_check, omnilist_run, omnilist_report · Private data: spend_gate_check, omnilist_run · Public sink: precross_analyze, regime_scan_board, omnilist_report · Destructive: spend_gate_check, omnilist_run, omnilist_report, omnigate_runtime_execute, omnigate_runtime_receipt.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: spend_gate_check, omnilist_run, omnilist_report · Private data: spend_gate_check, omnilist_run · Public sink: precross_analyze, regime_scan_board, omnilist_report · Destructive: spend_gate_check, omnilist_run, omnilist_report, omnigate_runtime_execute, omnigate_runtime_receipt

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
